# WallStreetMojo

> > Comprehensive finance, accounting, and investment banking education platform covering Excel, financial modeling, accounting standards, and career development.

WallStreetMojo provides in-depth tutorials, guides, and resources for finance professionals and students. Founded by Dheeraj Vaidya (CFA, FRM), the platform covers topics from Excel formulas and financial modeling to investment banking careers, accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP), and wealth management strategies.

## Key Topics

- Investment Banking
- Excel Formulas & Functions
- Financial Modeling
- Accounting Standards (IFRS vs GAAP)
- CFA & FRM Certification
- Estate Planning & Wealth Transfer
- Financial Independence (FIRE)
- Partnership Structures (FLP, LLC)
- Derivatives & ISDA
- Financial Ratios & Analysis
- Tax Minimization Strategies
- Asset Protection
- Book Recommendations

## Investment Banking & Finance Careers

- [Investment - Meaning, Types, Examples, How it Works?](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/investment): Investment basics covering stocks, debt, derivatives & financial goals
- [Investment Banking Roles & Responsibilities - What Are These?](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/investment-banking-roles-and-responsibilities): Investment banking career roles, responsibilities & qualification guide
- [Investment Banking in Houston - Top Banks, Culture, Salary](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/investment-banking-in-houston): Houston investment banking guide covering energy sector banks & careers

## Accounting Standards & Financial Reporting

- [IFRS vs Indian GAAP | Important Differences Between IFRS and Indian GAAP](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/ifrs-vs-indian-gaap): Comparison of IFRS and Indian GAAP accounting standards differences
- [Indirect Expenses (Meaning, Examples) | How to Calculate?](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/indirect-expenses): Indirect expenses guide covering types, calculation & accounting methods
- [Inventory Turnover Ratio - What Is It, Formula, Examples](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/inventory-turnover-ratio-formula): Inventory turnover ratio formula, calculation & efficiency improvement tips

## Excel Tutorials & Resources

- [WallStreetMojo | Excel Resources](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/blog/excel): Excel resources hub covering VLOOKUP, Analysis ToolPak & spreadsheet tools
- [How To Insert Function In Excel - Top 2 Methods To Insert Formulas](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/insert-function-in-excel): Excel tutorial on inserting formulas using equal sign & function dialog box

## Estate Planning & Partnership Structures

- [Family Limited Partnership (FLP) - What Is It, Advantages, Vs LLC](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/family-limited-partnership): Guide to FLP structure, comparing with LLC & irrevocable trust for estates
- [General Partnership - Definition, Vs Limited Partnership, Examples](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/general-partnership): General partnership business structure vs limited partnership explained
- [Financial Settlement - What Is It, Process, Types](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/financial-settlement): Financial settlement process for divorce, partnership & asset division

## Personal Finance & Wealth Building

- [Financial Independence Retire Early (FIRE) - Definition, Types](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/financial-independence-retire-early-fire): FIRE movement guide for early retirement through savings & passive income
- [Impact Investing - Definition, Examples, Importance, Types](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/impact-investing): Impact investing guide covering ESG, social responsibility & GIIN standards
- [Financial Freedom Books - Top 10 Must Read Books [2024]](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/financial-freedom-books): Top 10 financial freedom book recommendations for wealth building
- [Financial Management Books - List of 6 Best Books [2025]](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/best-financial-management-books): 6 best financial management books for 2025 with reviews & takeaways

## Derivatives & Fixed Income

- [International Swaps & Derivatives Association (ISDA)](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/international-swaps-and-derivatives-association-isda): ISDA overview: OTC derivatives master agreement & trade organization
- [Income Bond - Definition, Example (NS&I), How it Works?](https://www.wallstreetmojo.com/income-bond): Income bond definition with NS&I examples & interest payment mechanics
